This name conveys a sense of strength and stability, making it a fitting choice for a baby boy. The name Hahnke carries the meaning “Rocky, strong one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin.
